agyos_skill.intent: Azure Service Bus SDK for Python messaging. Use for queues, topics, subscriptions, and enterprise messaging patterns.
agyos_skill.instructions: Enterprise messaging for reliable cloud communication with queues and pub/sub topics. ```bash pip install azure-servicebus azure-identity ``` ```bash SERVICEBUS_FULLY_QUALIFIED_NAMESPACE=<namespace>.servicebus.windows.net SERVICEBUS_QUEUE_NAME=myqueue SERVICEBUS_TOPIC_NAME=mytopic SERVICEBUS_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME=mysubscription ``` ```python from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential from azure.servicebus import ServiceBusClient credential = DefaultAzureCredential() namespace = "<namespace>.servicebus.windows.net" client = ServiceBusClient( fully_qualified_namespace=namespace, credential=credential ) ``` | Client | Purpose | Get From | |--------|---------|----------| | `ServiceBusClient` | Connection management | Direct instantiation | | `ServiceBusSender` | Send messages | `client.get_queue_sender()` / `get_topic_sender()` | | `ServiceBusReceiver` | Receive messages | `client.get_queue_receiver()` / `get_subscription_receiver()` |
